tool_output.instruction: How can I insert a specific text into a new column in an Excel spreadsheet using VBA if three conditions are met in other columns? Specifically, when column A has the text 'Government', column B has 'Germany', and column C has 'Carretera', I want to automatically insert the word 'Volkswagen' into column Q. This process should be more efficient than using the filter function, as the sheet is quite large. VBA is preferred as it is already used for data import and cleanup.

tool_input.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('task/init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
print('dims', ws.dimensions, ws.max_row, ws.max_column)
for r in range(1, ws.max_row+1):
    q = ws.cell(r,17).value
    if q is not None:
        print(r, repr(ws.cell(r,1).value), repr(ws.cell(r,2).value), repr(ws.cell(r,3).value), '->', repr(q))
"
